slides.title: Policy measures aimed at stabilizing interest rates and diversifying funding sources
rows: Policy measures aimed at stabilizing interest rates and diversifying funding sources
Deposit and Lending Interest Rate Trends Over the Past 5 Years
Interest Rate Reductions Under Conclusion No. 106 (15 Oct)
Deposit rates to decrease by at least 0.5 ppts (tenors ≥6 months) and
lending rates by 1.5–2.0 ppts for businesses and priority sectors.
SBV requires banks to disclose average lending rates (Official Letter No.
9736), with strict measures against excessive rate increases.
The Government is exploring international bond issuance and increased
EU/Australian export financing for infrastructure and manufacturing.
Corporate Access to International Capital Markets
Reputable Vietnamese companies are issuing international bonds to
reduce reliance on domestic bank financing.
Measures to Reduce Costs for Households and Businesses
Proposed extension of VAT reductions (Nov 2026–Mar 2027), lower
rental taxes, and adjustments to material prices.
Source: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV); Official Letter No. 9736/NHNN-CSTT (21 Oct 2026); Government; Company Information; media reports.
